Definition: from G1144; to shed tears:--weep. Compare G2799.
BiblicalUsage: Jesus wept. Two words, the shortest verse in the Bible, and the whole of the incarnation is in them: the Lord who raises the dead first stands at the grave and weeps with the sisters who mourn.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe those two words are the answer to everyone who wonders whether God cares about our grief.
